name: get_active_project
description: Return the project this ChatCut desktop MCP invocation targets, as { projectId, surface: "desktop" } (projectId is null when a manually configured client is following the editor and no project is open). surface confirms this session operates the ChatCut Desktop app — the desktop window is the user-visible surface. Manually configured clients follow editor navigation; in-chat ACP Agent turns remain pinned to the project where they started. The other tools receive this same projectId implicitly, so passing it explicitly is not required.
